mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers Federal Reserve tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST and RSAFS growth fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression model has a negative coefficient with p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate to below 5.5% signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE is between 5.0% and 5.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 indicates weakening manufacturing activity and economic contraction, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO is below 105.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1100.0 thousand units signal strong consumer confidence and immediate economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1100.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 105.0 indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO is below 105.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and rising), Federal Reserve policy rate hikes increase borrowing costs and reduce corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during monetary tightening cycles, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.
